builds_on: crypto PR #5261 (arm D, study bwd-20261126/v1, research/binary-weil-descent-20261126), stacked on #5253 (study bcr-20261126/v1)
single_target: every solve is one cold solve of one public Q; no multi-target amortisation (owner instruction)
seed_derivation: unchanged #5253 seeds.rs: seed(parts) = first 8 bytes big-endian of SHA-256('bcr-20261126/v1|' + '|'.join(parts)); stream = SplitMix64(seed). The study prefix stays bcr-20261126/v1 so that curves, targets and relation-target streams are bitwise those of #5253 / #5261.
custody: d drawn from the 'target' stream inside the evaluator; solvers receive (curve, G, Q, ell); [d]G = Q checked inside the counted solve; d == d_true compared by the evaluator after the solve

D2.rule: fs = min(F-1, ceil(theta*F^beta)); beta = 2/3 is the k = 3 double-large-prime balance (Gaudry 2009, GTTD 2007) for LA ~ fs^2; theta from the held-out pilot

D2e.rule: beta = 2/(gamma+1) with gamma = 2.79, #5261's measured echelon exponent (balance of F^2/fs targets against fs^gamma LA); theta from the held-out pilot

D2all.rule: every class small (fs = F-1): must reproduce #5261's D record (d, targets, relations, columns) exactly; correctness control

references.D: #5261 records research/binary-weil-descent-20261126/data/runs_d.jsonl (same curves, targets, A1 stream, A2 echelon), n = 18..48
references.RHO: negation-map rho, 16 seeds per target: #5253 data/runs.jsonl (n = 18..33), #5261 data/runs_ext_ref.jsonl (n = 36..48), this study (n = 51, 54) with the unchanged #5253 rho module (rho.rs by #[path]) and the lanes below

linear_algebra: #5253 A2 incremental echelon mod ell, unchanged (sparse LA deliberately not used)

pilot_choices.theta: argmin of sum over n in {30,36,42} of log gmean Meq(s=1,u=1), 4 held-out cases per rung: beta = 2/3 -> theta = 4 (score 54.004; 8: 54.069; 16: 54.268; 2: 54.965); beta = 0.528 -> theta = 16 (53.931; 32: 54.061; 8: 54.385). data/pilot_theta.jsonl, 144 records, all correct
pilot_choices.rho_lanes: argmin mean Meq over W in {16,32,64,128,256}, 2 held-out curves x 8 targets: n = 51 -> 128 (2.085e8; 256: 2.265e8; 64: 2.521e8); n = 54 -> 64 (3.989e8; 128: 4.023e8). n = 57, 60 pilot stopped (rungs not run; see PROTOCOL.md)

resources.rule: a killed/failed process is a resource-limit record, never a negative result; the run continues with the next rung

primary_metric: Meq(s=1,u=1) of the whole cold solve (factor base, setup, target stream, oracle, relation replay, large-prime graph, LA, [d]G = Q); #5253 unit unchanged
band: u in {0, 0.1, 1} for non-field units (graph steps are h, z, za units), s in {1, 0.25}; order between arms stated only where it holds across the band (AGENTS.md 5a)
analysis: b2lp_harness analyze: paired per-case ratios D2/rho, D2e/rho, D/rho, D2/D, D2e/D, D2/D2e; per-rung geometric mean with hierarchical bootstrap B=10000 (2000 band); rho A/A; D2all == D identity; census; exponent fits; crossover projection (model)

checks.logs: [d]G = Q in-solve and d == d_true, every solve; D2/D2e d equal to D's d on every shared case
checks.yields: every relation fed to the LA (full or combined) checked by the group law: sum e_c [h]P_c = [a][h]G + [b][h]Q exactly (uncounted, wall excluded)
checks.partial_relations: every decomposition resolved into signs by the group law before it enters the graph (#5253 resolve)
checks.D2all_eq_D: (d, targets, relations, columns) of D2all equal #5261's D record on every case n = 18..39
checks.replay: n=30 ci=0 ti=0 arm D2 rerun from the frozen manifest, bitwise compare of all fields but wall times

falsifier: parity at a rung if the upper 95% bound of D2/rho (or D2e/rho) <= 1 there; such a rung then requires the rho A/A floor and full verification before it is stated
exclusions: none; every record, failure, kill and mismatch is retained
